[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 15 July 2026.

[2026-07-15_CRYPTO]  
Video Title: Crypto Golden Breakdown & DCA model  
Video ID: KCUqIrAyVSk  
Crypto Golden Breakdown & DCA model (CRYPTO) | Class: CRYPTO  

   

Current Structure  
The market is in a deep accumulation phase with Bitcoin and ETH trading near their 4‑year low points yet still above the 20% accumulation threshold. The 200‑day SMA sits roughly 5% below the current price for Bitcoin and 3% for ETH, indicating a modest upside bias. Composite risk scores are 31 for Bitcoin and 32 for ETH, both comfortably under the 0.33 risk ceiling, while social sentiment shows a 15% increase in bullish content over the past week.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
TWAP baselines are anchored at the 4‑year low, with a 31% weekly DCA allocation generating an alpha of 31% per week; scaling to $150 weekly DCA yields a similar alpha. Regression fair‑value bands suggest a 10% upside potential before a 5% drawdown threshold is breached. The model flags a “crash‑by” regime when the rolling z‑score deviates >2σ, currently only triggered for Bitcoin but not for LINK, which has moved into a shallow risk zone.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
Machine‑learning forecasts project a 12% upside target for Bitcoin and ETH within the next 30 days, with a panic‑drawdown floor at −8% and a non‑panic floor at −4%. Macro moving‑average supports lie at the 50‑day SMA for both assets, while the cycle bull target aligns with the 90‑day momentum peak, expected around $60,000 for Bitcoin and $4,000 for ETH.

records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 28 June 2026.

[2026-06-28_CRYPTO]  
Video Title: Opportunity cost analysis for Cryptos | Crypto Pairs: Lagrangian Galaxy  
Video ID: EqmsR0QIAhs  
Opportunity cost analysis for Cryptos | Crypto Pairs: Lagrangian Galaxy (CRYPTO) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
• The ETH/BTC ratio is trending downward from the August 2025 high, placing ETH in a lagging zone relative to BTC.  
• ETH sits above its 20 week, 100 week, and 200 week SMAs, indicating an over‑extended position; the SMA bottoming indicator shows Bitcoin at 0.23 and ETH at 0.20, both near accumulation territory.  
• Composite risk scores: LINK 0.52, BNB slightly higher, TRON 0.86, SOL 0.43; these reflect relative stability or over‑extension.  
• Social‑sentiment word‑cloud momentum skews neutral‑to‑positive for stable assets (BNB, LINK) and slightly bearish for over‑extended tokens (TRON, SOL).  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
• TWAP baseline for ETH sits at gravity level 2, not in accumulation territory; risk is 50% (precisely 0.545) and 5% mean‑reversion pressure is low.  
• Regression fair‑value bands: the 95% confidence band encloses most moves; deep‑discount zone (2σ or 95% percentile) lies below the blue band, while the over‑extended zone peaks at 96%.  
• Undervaluation/overvaluation residuals: ETH at level 2 (neither undervalued nor overvalued), TRON in the over‑extended zone at 96%, and SOL in a mild over‑extended state.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
• ML forecast models project a forward return of -9% for ETH/BTC, +8% for SOL/BTC, and a 42% increment for TRON/BTC.  
• Panic‑drawdown support floors are near the accumulation threshold (0.20), while non‑panic floors lie above this level.  
• Macro moving‑average supports: ETH above all SMAs, TRON above 20, 100, and 200 week SMAs, indicating a bullish bias; SOL in a lagging area with a forward projection of -20%.  
• Cycle bull targets: a one‑standard‑deviation bull case for ETH could lift it above current levels, while a one‑standard‑deviation bear case could push it below the 20 week SMA; similar one‑σ ranges apply to TRON and SOL.
